craft_notes: Sthāyin: procession. Rows: pour, follow, recite. Read aloud: circumambulation.

lines: Then the pupil pouring the stream round the house for stumbling-quelling,
with jar let him follow, this spell reciting:
ho, ho! Indra! by thee in thine own quarter, for stumbling-pacifying.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tataḥ śiṣyaṃ gṛhaparyanteṣu vighnaśamanāya dhārāṃ pātayantaṃ sakumbho 'nugacchet imaṃ mantraṃ paṭhan bho bhoḥ śakra tvayā svasyāṃ diśi vighnapraśāntaye

reads_against.argmap: pouring round; guru follows with Indra verse
